title: ECDC: DRC Ebola toll reaches 10,920 confirmed cases and 5,323 deaths; eight provinces affected
detail: ECDC's 9 November update reports 10,920 confirmed cases and 5,323 related deaths in the DRC as of 8 November (data to 7 November), up from 10,668 cases and 5,198 deaths reported 4 November. Community transmission is ongoing across eight provinces. ECDC also records the Nigeria case (reported 20 October, travel history to Uganda, medically evacuated to Switzerland, 53 contacts identified) and Kenya's first imported case announced 6 October.
